authoring: Manually derived from pinned normative rules and the explicit E04 research display policy; no candidate parser, normalizer, mapper or runner was called to create expected data. The counting verifier cannot interpret Markdown or calculate query relations.

coordinate_policy.source: Original valid UTF-8 S byte offsets, half-open spans
coordinate_policy.parse: Normalized UTF-8 P byte offsets, half-open spans
coordinate_policy.logical: Per-flow UTF-16 scalar boundaries, half-open spans
coordinate_policy.ids: Flow, structure, object and payload IDs are document-local u32 IDs in their respective typed namespaces; fragment IDs are unique across the document's flows.
coordinate_policy.query_key: Each query carries the complete case SourceKey and an explicit Flow target; a key_override is an intentional negative query.
coordinate_policy.display: No terminal paragraph separator. LF separates blocks/rows; TAB separates table cells. A code block keeps its content LF. Task marker emits U+FFFC, consumed spacer is Hidden, then a Synthetic SP precedes the label. Raw HTML is an inert literal.
coordinate_policy.separator_anchors: Task SP: after consumed marker spacer, at label start. Table TAB/LF: after trim/pipe/row grammar preceding the current cell, at current raw inline content start (before inline delimiters); missing final cell: row content end after trailing pipe, before line ending.

provenance.derivation: The empty source has no origins, no fragments and one Exact 0-to-0 boundary. This is an input/mapping control, not a parser compatibility assertion.
A real accepted definition produces no body node. Its entire source is Hidden; label a and destination /u remain dependency payloads.
Artificial fully specified trace. abcde are intentionally hidden and two separators inserted. No Markdown parser is asserted to produce this document.

rules: CM Characters and lines; Insecure characters
provenance.derivation: Manually enumerated S scalars and CRLF atom, then copied normalized P into L as a control. This is not prose soft-break projection.
U+FEFF and TAB are preserved. The serialized JSON contains U+FEFF within the source string; the JSON file itself has no BOM.
[x] is a checked task marker followed by a TAB whitespace. Marker is exactly [2,5); TAB [5,6) is consumed and Hidden. Synthetic SP at S6 precedes CJK label.

rules: GFM Tables (extension): fewer and excess body cells
provenance.derivation: Two header columns. Row 1 lacks column 1, represented by a zero-width Cell and a TAB. Row 2 has an excess q cell, whose source is Hidden. TAB anchors S3/S15/S19; row LF anchors S13/S17 after leading table grammar and before the new cell raw inline content. Missing cell anchor S15 is after the closing pipe and before its LF.

rules: GFM Tables: escaped pipe inside code span
provenance.derivation: Table-specific pipe preprocessing consumes the backslash inside code. Body cell contains literal |. Row LF is anchored at S9 after outer pipe consumption and before the cell opening backtick; code delimiter is cell inline grammar, Hidden after Insert. Source [10,12) is one minimum pipe Transform atom.

provenance.selector: Tabs: example with > followed by two U+2192 tab placeholders and foo
provenance.adaptation: Spec U+2192 tab placeholders decoded to U+0009 under the spec convention; LF retained. Original spec bytes and notices remain unchanged at the pinned normative source.
provenance.derivation: The first tab is wholly consumed by quote prefix/indent. Four columns of code indent leave two visible columns from the second tab. Whole second tab becomes exactly two spaces; it is never split into half a source byte.
One code span crosses the quote continuation. The code LF becomes one space, the second quote prefix is Hidden, and a and b remain separate exact Copy runs.

rules: CM Images; Emphasis and strong emphasis
provenance.derivation: Main is one U+FFFC over [0,11). Alt domain is the original label [2,7), L starts at 0 and reads a b; alt emphasis is nested within the alt label root. Destination u [9,10) is a dependency payload.

rules: CM Images; Backslash escapes; Link destinations and titles
provenance.derivation: Image envelope is [0,14). Alt a* is two UTF-16 units while Main has one. The escape source [3,5) is atomic in alt, destination /u [7,9) and title t [11,12) are distinct payloads.
The empty label is anchored at original S2; its L0 does not correspond to S0. Main remains one Object. Aux has no source claims or contributors.

rules: CM Link reference definitions: title on following line; first matching definition wins
provenance.derivation: Use [0,6) resolves to definition [8,21), destination /u [13,15), following-line title t [19,20). Duplicate [22,29) remains a recognized but unaccepted definition with /v provenance. Newlines outside the syntax spans are explicit Hidden grammar.
Two links have different labels and separate source occurrences. Equal decoded destination u does not merge Link or payload identities: u comes from [4,5) and [11,12).

rules: CM HTML blocks; Characters and lines; Insecure characters
provenance.derivation: An opaque raw HTML block is displayed literally. No tags, attributes or script are executed or converted to action links. CRLF becomes LF and literal NUL becomes U+FFFD before literal projection.
The unchanged code content abc must be Copy. A whole-content Transform would lose exact internal a/b/c boundaries despite passing a coarse partition/length check.

fidelity_negative_controls.reason: WholeCode is not an allowed transformation atom; internal exact queries must not pass as Atomic.

rules: CM Entity and numeric character references
provenance.derivation: Each independent & is a distinct Transform. The original boundary S5 and decoded boundary L1 are exactly related, with both adjacent contributors and no Atomic flag.

fidelity_negative_controls.reason: Two normative entity atoms cannot be merged into a single Atomic relation that destroys S5/L1 exactness.

rules: GFM Autolinks (extension): interior punctuation is included
E04 G4 hook before delimiter resolution
provenance.derivation: All 29 source characters belong to one extended www autolink. Interior _, * and ~~ remain literal label/path characters; no Emphasis or Strikethrough records are emitted. Destination gains http:// as a Synthetic payload prefix, absent from Main L.

rules: GFM Autolinks (extension): allowed start after * and trailing * exclusion
provenance.derivation: The leading * permits the www start; the trailing * is excluded from the URL, and the external pair resolves as emphasis. Link is nested inside Emphasis and the label is exact Copy.
A code span excludes extended autolink matching. The text www.a.com remains code Copy, without a Link or destination payload.

rules: CM Links: no links nested inside links
provenance.derivation: There is exactly one explicit Link whose label is www.a.com and whose destination is /u. The label must not become a nested auto-Link or change its destination to http://www.a.com.

rules: CM HTML blocks: complete standalone open tag (type 7)
E04 inert literal policy; G4 excluded raw HTML context
provenance.derivation: The complete standalone tag is raw HTML. The attribute text must not become an autolink or an action; all bytes display literally.
One header cell is an extended www autolink. No body rows or cell/row separators are invented. Header pipes and delimiter row are Hidden; the generated http:// is payload-only.

rules: GFM Autolinks (extension): no underscore in last two domain segments
provenance.derivation: The domain has an underscore in its penultimate segment. The entire input is literal prose, with no Link or payload. This small semantic rejection does not establish bounded long-URL scanning.

rules: CM Full reference links; Link reference definitions
provenance.derivation: Distinct labels a/b resolve to distinct accepted definitions [15,21)/[22,28), even though both destinations decode to u. Each use and source occurrence has its own identity and target provenance.

pending.reason: The exact identity of decoded destination origins around escaped/entity text in extended autolinks needs an independently reviewed normative derivation. No guessed expected result is supplied.

Bounded matcher lookahead and cancellation are cost/control obligations. A very long input is not automatically invalid Markdown and cannot receive a fabricated semantic failure golden; fixture/output/cost policy awaits review.
Synthetic final code LF and trailing blank-line provenance require a distinct reviewed projection rule; existing m1.1 semantic inputs remain required and unchanged.
